instruction: Modify VS Code to enable relative line numbers and set the ruler at column 80.

metadata.explanation: This task requires the agent to configure editor display settings. The evaluator checks that 'editor.lineNumbers' is set to 'relative' and 'editor.rulers' contains [80]. These settings are popular among developers for code navigation and line length guidelines.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both instruction requirements: relative line numbers and ruler at column 80
Getter logic correctly extracts VS Code settings.json from the expected location (/home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json)
Metric function check_json_settings correctly handles the expected parameter structure when type='rule'
Expected values are semantically correct: 'editor.lineNumbers': 'relative' and 'editor.rulers': [80]
Settings.json persists after agent actions, so no postconfig needed for state accessibility
Complete coverage: both settings are checked with exact value matching

metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
